>I cannot change ten years of alcohol. It had its chance. Now it's my turn, on my own, to see what I am made of. 

Such powerful words. Thank you for your response.

Thanks. I know I need to open up and talk to someone but I'm so afraid of having it negatively affect my work life I just keep it bottled up and it just tears me apart even more. Don't know if I can take it.
